choices.name: Latent Powers
choices.text: A Warlord with this Warlord trait gains the Psyker (x) special rule. If the Warlord already has the Psyker (x) special rule, increase the value of (x) by 1.

choices.name: The Voice of Lorgar
choices.text: All friendly units within 18" of a model with this Warlord trait count as scoring 1 additional Wound for the purposes of Combat Resolution. In addition, friendly units within 18" of a model with this Warlord Trait may re-roll Pinning and Panic tests.

choices.name: Unbreakable Devotion
choices.text: A Warlord with this trait gains the Indomitable Spirit (3+) special rule. In addition, the Warlord automatically passes all Pinning and Panic tests.
